statements.JinWishart.measurable_coordinateMembersh: (E : Set ℝ) (hE : MeasurableSet E) : Measurable (coordinateMembershipCount (n := n) E)
statements.JinWishart.andreief_det_product_integrab: (f g : Fin n → ℝ → ℝ) (hfg : ∀ i j,Integrable (fun y => f i y*g j y) μ) : Integrable (fun z : Fin n → ℝ => (Matrix.of (fun i j => f i (z j))).det*(Matrix.of (fun i j => g i (z j))).det) (Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin n => μ))
statements.JinWishart.split_andreief_count_polynomi: (f g : Fin n → ℝ → ℝ) (hfg : ∀ i j,Integrable (fun y => f i y*g j y) μ) (E : Set ℝ) (hE : MeasurableSet E) : (rowAffinePolynomialMatrix (Matrix.of (fun i j => ∫ y in E,f i y*g j y ∂μ)) (Matrix.of (fun i j => ∫ y in Eᶜ,f i y*g j y ∂μ))).det= ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n+1),Polynomial.C ((1/(n.factorial : ℝ))*countDeterminantMoment f g μ E k)*Polynomial.X^k
statements.JinWishart.split_andreief_count_coeffici: (f g : Fin n → ℝ → ℝ) (hfg : ∀ i j,Integrable (fun y => f i y*g j y) μ) (E : Set ℝ) (hE : MeasurableSet E) (k : ℕ) (hk : k≤n) : ((rowAffinePolynomialMatrix (Matrix.of (fun i j => ∫ y in E,f i y*g j y ∂μ)) (Matrix.of (fun i j => ∫ y in Eᶜ,f i y*g j y ∂μ))).det).coeff k= (1/(n.factorial : ℝ))*countDeterminantMoment f g μ E k
statements.JinWishart.split_andreief_count_rowMix: (f g : Fin n → ℝ → ℝ) (hfg : ∀ i j,Integrable (fun y => f i y*g j y) μ) (E : Set ℝ) (hE : MeasurableSet E) (k : ℕ) (hk : k≤n) : (∑ S ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n)).powerset, if S.card=k then (rowMix (Matrix.of (fun i j => ∫ y in E,f i y*g j y ∂μ)) (Matrix.of (fun i j => ∫ y in Eᶜ,f i y*g j y ∂μ)) S).det else 0)= (1/(n.factorial : ℝ))*countDeterminantMoment f g μ E k
